name: kindle-highlights
title_zh: Kindle 笔记导出器，连亚马逊截断的划线也捞回来
tagline_zh: 别再手动翻网页复制了。一次导出整本书的划线，带页码和位置引用，还能找回 Kindle 导出上限之外被隐藏的笔记。
tagline_en: Stop copy-pasting from the web. Export a whole book's highlights with page & location cites, and recover notes.
desc_en: Extract a book's highlights from the Kindle notebook (read.amazon.com/notebook) into one verbatim, location-cited Markdown file, and recover highlights that Amazon's export limit truncated or hid — using the Mac Kindle app's synced annotation positions plus the Cloud Reader's rendered pages. Use when the user wants to export, extract, copy, or save Kindle book notes/highlights.
why_zh: 它不信任亚马逊的导出接口，而是交叉比对 Mac Kindle 的本地同步位置和云端渲染页。
why_en: It doesn't trust Amazon's export API. It cross-references your Mac Kindle's synced positions with Cloud Reader pages to restore.
limit_zh: 仅限 Mac 上的 Kindle 应用且需已同步该书笔记；只处理已购或借阅的 Kindle 书。
limit_en: Requires Mac Kindle app with synced annotations for the book; works only for Kindle purchases/loans, not PDFs or personal docs. Output is Markdown.
title_en: Kindle highlight extractor that recovers Amazon-truncated.
